_comment: Words that blur a post on the Global feed (tap to reveal). Whole-word, case-insensitive, after leetspeak normalisation (0→o 1→i 3→e 4→a 5→s @→a $→s), so list inflections, not spellings. Multi-word entries work. This file is the app's built-in fallback AND the source pushed to Firestore config/moderation.sensitiveTerms — edit here, then push. Deliberately excluded because they'd blur ordinary posts: shit, damn, ass (everyday venting), puke (English 'vomit'), paki (Taglish 'please'), gaga (Lady Gaga), die/kill (grief, and threats are blocked separately).
